{"items": [{"type": "obligation", "text": "All instructional materials, including teacher's manuals, films, tapes, or other supplementary material which will be used in connection with any survey, analysis, or evaluation as part of any applicable program shall be available for inspection by the parents or guardians of the children.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null}, {"type": "obligation", "text": "No student shall be required, as part of any applicable program, to submit to a survey, analysis, or evaluation that reveals information concerning-", "force": "prohibition", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": "without the prior written consent of the parent"}, {"type": "obligation", "text": "Except as provided in subsections (a) and (b), a local educational agency that receives funds under any applicable program shall develop and adopt policies, in consultation with parents, regarding the following:", "force": "obligation", "binds": "a local educational agency that receives funds under any applicable program", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "in consultation with parents"}]}
